title: Contingency Placement Agreements: Annual Allowances for Remittance and Credit Reporting Changes
content:
Under the Contingency Placement Agreements, the number of changes a creditor client may make to its terms in one agreement year, and the lead time before a remittance change can apply, depend on the tier.

| Tier | Remittance basis or frequency changes per agreement year | Credit reporting authorization changes per agreement year | Lead days before a remittance change can apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 0 | 1 | 15 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 1 | 1 | 15 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 1 | 2 | 10 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 2 | 2 | 10 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 2 | 4 | 5 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 4 | 4 | 5 |

**What each column means**

- *Remittance basis or frequency changes* — changes of remittance basis or frequency allowed per agreement year, counted together. An allowance of 0 means no such change is allowed on that tier.
- *Credit reporting authorization changes* — changes of the client's credit reporting authorization allowed per agreement year.
- *Lead days* — the calendar days after a terms change request before the first remittance period the change can apply to begins.

**Hypothetical reading.** A Standard Contingency Agreement client that has already had one remittance frequency change processed in the current agreement year has used its allowance of 1 for remittance basis and frequency changes; its allowance of 1 credit reporting authorization change is counted separately.
